snippet.title: Escape The Backrooms | Official Console Launch Trailer ☢️
snippet.description:
Escape the Backrooms has no-clipped onto consoles and is now available on Xbox Series X|S – including PC and Xbox Game Pass - and PlayStation 5!

Team up with these new folks using the brand-new cross-platform lobby code system, create new friends and memories, and most importantly, dance around the party table in Level Fun while humming You Day and chugging Almond Water! Oh, and not dying I suppose... 

Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/escape-the-backrooms/9MW15L8FRT9P/0010
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10010992

Follow Secret Mode: https://linktr.ee/wearesecretmode
Support us directly: https://store.wearesecretmode.com/
